A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same work, Self-Evolved Reward Learning for LLMs, with readable main text and Appendices A–F. Pages 2–23 have identical extracted text and rendered appearance; the differences are confined to page 1.

before.justification: v2 reports original reward-modeling experiments in Table 1, PPO evaluations in Figure 4, and additional cost, labeling, and benchmark results in Appendices E–F.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original reward-modeling, PPO, and appendix experiments, including Tables 1 and 4–7.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain identical self-labeling, learning-status assessment, data filtering, pairwise reward-model retraining, and PPO procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use HH-RLHF, UltraFeedback, Summarize/TL;DR, and StackOverflow, and retain the RewardBench, MT-Bench, and Arena-Hard evaluations in Appendix F. No dataset, task, or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: Loop 0 and Full Dataset in reward-modeling comparisons, and SFT and full-dataset-guided PPO in the corresponding downstream evaluations. The labeling alternatives in Table 4 also remain identical.

E3.justification: Appendices C–D retain the same data splits, model configurations, training budgets, preprocessing, accuracy metric, and GPT-4 evaluation procedures. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The iteration and data-selection analyses, PPO learning curves, reward-score distributions, GPT-4 evaluation case study, and labeling-cost comparisons are unchanged, including Figures 2–3 and 5–6 and Tables 3–4.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same statistical reporting, including the standard-deviation shading in Figure 5. No repeated-run information, seed counts, uncertainty estimates, or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains Llama 3 8B HH-RLHF accuracies of 56.9 for Loop 0, 68.56 for SER, and 70.45 for Full Dataset; the appendix results also match exactly.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions in Section 3 and the assumptions, two convergence theorems, and proofs in Appendix A are identical. No derivation or formal argument changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same scientific claims and contributions, including using 15% annotated seed data to approach full-data performance through self-evolved reward learning.

C2.justification: Interpretations of iterative improvement, diminishing benefits from easy examples, model-size effects, and annotation-cost tradeoffs remain unchanged. Section 5 retains the same qualifications about empirical filtering and future integration of LLM response generation.

D1.justification: v3 adds an abstract sentence directing readers to https://aka.ms/ser for paper resources; v2 has no corresponding resource pointer. Implementation details and hyperparameters are unchanged. The PDFs alone do not establish the contents or availability of the linked resources.

R1.justification: Section 2, research-positioning passages, and the reference list are unchanged. No cited work or relationship to prior research is added or revised.

P1.justification: v3 adds one resource-access sentence to the abstract, removes Zhizhen Fan's internship marker and Lu Wang's corresponding-author marker and footnote, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The remaining prose and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added abstract sentence and removed footnote cause localized first-page reflow, and the margin stamp changes. All figures, tables, and layouts on pages 2–23 are identical.

improvement.justification: The new resource pointer in v3's abstract provides a modest documentation and discoverability benefit absent from v2. Scientific content, evidence, and appendices are unchanged. The improvement is limited to access information because the supplied PDFs do not verify the linked materials.
